bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; individual income; requiring an addition for traveling expenses related to immigration enforcement; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0131, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0131, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 21.

Traveling expenses incurred while performing or supporting immigration enforcement activities.

(a) The traveling expenses of a taxpayer are an addition, provided that the traveling expenses were:

(1) paid for by the taxpayer's employer or paid for by the taxpayer and reimbursed by the employer; and

(2) incurred while traveling in Minnesota to perform immigration enforcement activities or to provide material support to immigration enforcement activities.

(b) For the purposes of this section, "traveling expenses" means travel fares, meals, lodging, and other expenses incident to travel.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for taxable years after December 31, 2025.
